_about: The original demo persona: the REAL Miami Foundation, its real public website context, and real organization donors (9-12) with INVENTED gift histories. Kept so the team can flip back with org_config.json "persona": "miami_foundation" (or DONOR_DESK_PERSONA=miami_foundation). Its data stays where it was: "files" points at the existing caches instead of copying them. URLs moved here from org_config.json; socials verified from miamifoundation.org's own footer links (Sat Nov 7); it links no X account, so x_url stays null.
